title: connectPagination createURL is off-by-one
body:
### 🐛 Current behavior

When fixing #5236 in #5696, I believe we made an off-by-one error, and the createURL doesn't match the previous value of createURL, nor does it match refine.

### 🔍 Steps to reproduce

```
const { canRefine, pages, refine } = usePagination(props);

createURL(0) => Gives another url as refine(0)
createURL(1) => Gives another url as refine(1)
```

### Live reproduction

/

### 💭 Expected behavior

createURL and refine behave the same

### Package version

after #5696
